author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding G, hearing a pattern repeat lower, the song's high and low points, and soft two-hand playing, with a calm Christmas carol.

classes.title: Rock the cradle: G, A, G
classes.goal: Find G by the three black keys and learn the first half.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys to find where the tune starts

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find G by the three black keys, then rock to A and back.
classes.childAction: Find G, then rock G, A, G, and settle on E.
classes.bridge: G, A, G is a cradle rocking; E is the baby settling down.

intro.caption: Let's find the cradle note
intro.parentCue: help your child find G by the three black keys.

games.caption: Silent night: G, A, G, E
games.parentCue: Rock side to side with the tune

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding G and the rocking first line.

classes.title: Calm, then bright, step down
classes.goal: Learn the next part: the same little shape, played one step lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The second half copies the first, one step lower

classes.parentPrompt: Play 'all is calm', then 'all is bright'; ask your child what changed.
classes.childAction: Play D, D, B, then the same shape lower: C, C, G.
classes.bridge: 'All is bright' is 'all is calm' taking one step down to the left.

intro.caption: Same shape, one step down
intro.parentCue: ask your child what changed the second time.

games.caption: Calm, then bright, a step lower
games.parentCue: Ask: same shape, higher or lower?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a shape repeat one step lower.

classes.title: Up to the star, home to bed
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and find its highest and lowest notes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Lines repeat, rise to the highest note, then settle home low

classes.parentPrompt: Point up when the song reaches its highest note; point down at the very end.
classes.childAction: Play the whole song slowly; find the highest note.
classes.bridge: The song rocks, climbs to a star at the top, then settles home.

intro.caption: Find the star at the top
intro.parentCue: point up at the highest note.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the shape of a whole song, high and low.

classes.title: From high C to low C
classes.goal: Practise the last line slowly, from high C all the way home to low C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The last line starts on high C and ends on low C

classes.parentPrompt: Play it slowly first; name both C's, the high house and the low house.
classes.childAction: Walk down slowly from high C all the way home to C.
classes.bridge: 'Sleep in heavenly peace' walks down the stairs from high C to low C.

intro.caption: Walk down the stairs to bed
intro.parentCue: name the high C, then the low C.

games.caption: From high C down home
games.parentCue: Play slowly; land softly on low C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: walking down from one C to the next.

classes.title: The low guitar note
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: The left hand plays low notes, on the left side

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count bars aloud so your child plays one low note each.
classes.childAction: Play one low note with your left hand on each 'one'.
classes.bridge: The left hand plays low, like the guitar on the very first night.

intro.caption: The low guitar note
intro.parentCue: count one at each new bar

games.caption: Same C, two houses
games.parentCue: Ask: which C sounds like a guitar?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: Two hands, soft as snow
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low left-hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each hand has its own job; they meet on the 'one'

classes.parentPrompt: Go very slowly; say 'one' each time both hands play together.
classes.childAction: Left hand on 'one', right hand plays the tune, slowly.
classes.bridge: Both hands land together on 'one', soft as snowflakes.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: go very slowly and stop while it's fun.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: giving each hand its own job.

classes.title: Float along with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole carol along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and sway the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep going!
classes.bridge: The music is a quiet night; float along and keep going.

intro.caption: Float along with the music
intro.parentCue: sway the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: A quiet night for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole carol softly for teddy, holding the long notes, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing softly and slowly, with long, held notes

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy close and play softly together, then take a quiet bow.
classes.childAction: Play softly for teddy, hold the long notes, then bow.
classes.bridge: Soft fingers, long notes: a quiet, starry night for teddy.

intro.caption: A quiet concert for teddy
intro.parentCue: sit teddy close, ready to listen.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: soft, calm playing, start to end.
